top_signals.title: ‘You Can’t Fool the Bond,’ Says BofA’s Cabana on the Fed
top_signals.summary: Mark Cabana, head of US rates strategy at BofA Global Research, says the Federal Reserve now has a credibility issue as he discusses the bond market’s reaction to last week’s interest rate decision from the Fed. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: India’s New Stock Closing Auction Sparks Confusion on Debut
top_signals.summary: India’s new system to discover end-of-day market prices got off to a confusing start, with traders trying to make sense of a spike in the NSE Nifty 50 Index stemming from the shift.
